# Requirements Inventory Taxonomy

## Business Capability

A business ability the solution must enable.

## Business Flow / Scenario

A business process step, interaction flow, or scenario that must be supported.

## Actor / Stakeholder

A participating role, user type, external party, team, or stakeholder.

## System / Interface

A system, subsystem, platform, application, or integration interface referenced by the requirement.

## Data / Information

A business data element, information object, document, message, or record relevant to the solution.

## Constraint / Policy

A rule, compliance obligation, policy, regulatory condition, dependency, or architectural constraint.

## Non-Functional Intent

A quality expectation such as performance, security, availability, auditability, scalability, maintainability, or usability.

## Risk / Open Point

An unresolved issue, assumption, dependency risk, ambiguity, or decision that requires follow-up.
